action: No action needed; for awareness. Watch the FAA, Microsoft, JPMorgan Chase and the NSA for their own findings on each outage.
date_note: Rubio spoke Wednesday morning in Manila (Tuesday evening in Miami), per the Miami Herald/TNS article dated 19 November; Latin Times published on 18 November.
exec: US officials say several recent outages are unrelated and not a systemic attack, so the incidents are being handled separately.
plain: After outages at Microsoft, the FAA, JPMorgan Chase and the NSA, the US Secretary of State said there is no evidence they are linked or that the country is under systemic attack.

sources.name: Miami Herald / TNS via Jefferson City News Tribune, 19 Nov 2026

summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters in Manila "We are not under systemic attack" and that there was "zero evidence" the recent Microsoft, FAA, JPMorgan Chase and NSA outages were related. The Miami Herald reports the causes cited were an upgrade problem (Microsoft), excess data traffic (FAA), a software bug (Chase) and scheduled maintenance (NSA). Latin Times says Sean Duffy said no definitive root cause was pinpointed.
title: Rubio says no evidence US outages are linked or a systemic attack

validation.note: Miami Herald/TNS and Latin Times each report Rubio's statement. Quotes differ in wording between the two pages. No State Department transcript read. Rubio's statement is an official's claim, not a CyberView conclusion.

review.note: Quotes, date, causes and Duffy statement match the Miami Herald/TNS and Latin Times pages. Summary was over 75 words and attributed causes loosely; trimmed and attributed causes to the Miami Herald.
